from datetime import datetime

# Determine current date from phone app
current = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
print('phone current:', current)

# We'll treat yesterday as dinner date
# Parse date string like 'Saturday, May 20, 2023'
import re
m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z]+),\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})", current['date'])
if not m:
    raise ValueError('Unexpected date format')
month_str = m.group(2)
day = int(m.group(3))
year = int(m.group(4))
import calendar
month = list(calendar.month_name).index(month_str)
now_date = datetime(year, month, day)
yesterday = now_date - __import__('datetime').timedelta(days=1)
print('now_date:', now_date.date(), 'yesterday:', yesterday.date())

yesterday_str = yesterday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
today_str = now_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('yesterday_str:', yesterday_str, 'today_str:', today_str)

# Fetch note 3084 content
simple_note_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
simple_note_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=simple_note_pw)['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=simple_note_token)
print('note title:', note['title'], 'created_at:', note['created_at'])
print(note['content'])

# Parse shares lines: '- Name => $Amount'
shares = []
for line in note['content'].splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('-') and '=>' in line:
        # extract name and amount
        left, right = line[1:].split('=>',1)
        name = left.strip()
        amt_str = right.strip()
        if amt_str.startswith('$'):
            amt = float(amt_str[1:].strip())
        else:
            amt = float(amt_str)
        shares.append((name, amt))
print('parsed shares:', shares)

share_amounts = [amt for _, amt in shares]
print('share_amounts:', share_amounts)

m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z]+),\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})", phone_now['date'])
month_str = m.group(2)
day = int(m.group(3))

import calendar
month = list(calendar.month_name).index(month_str)
now_date = datetime(year, month, day)

# Load simple_note content for note 3084 (most recent Work Dinner)
simple_note_token = globals().get('simple_note_token')
assert simple_note_token

print('using note:', note['title'], 'created_at', note['created_at'])

# Parse shares
shares = {}
for line in note['content'].splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('-') and '=>' in line:
        left,right = line[1:].split('=>',1)
        name = left.strip()
        amt_part = right.strip()
        if amt_part.startswith('$'):
            amt = float(amt_part[1:].strip())
        else:
            amt = float(amt_part)
        shares[name]=amt
print('parsed shares:', shares)

# Map phone coworker first names to emails
# coworkers variable should exist
coworkers_list = globals().get('coworkers')
print('coworkers_list count:', len(coworkers_list))
first_to_email = {}
for c in coworkers_list:
    fn = c.get('first_name')
    email = c.get('email')
    if fn and email:
        first_to_email[fn] = email
print('first_to_email keys:', sorted(first_to_email.keys()))

# Determine expected recipient emails from note names
note_names = list(shares.keys())
recipients = []
missing=[]
for name in note_names:
    email = first_to_email.get(name)
    if not email:
        missing.append(name)
    else:
        recipients.append({'name':name, 'email':email, 'amount':shares[name]})
print('recipients computed:', recipients)
print('missing names:', missing)

# Fetch venmo received transactions in date range

        break
    received.extend(res)

        break

print('received tx count in range:', len(received))

# Filter to relevant senders
recipient_emails = set([r['email'] for r in recipients])
share_amounts_by_email = {r['email']: r['amount'] for r in recipients}

# Mark paid if exists tx from sender.email with amount matching share
paid_emails=set()
for tx in received:
    sender_email = tx.get('sender',{}).get('email')
    amt = tx.get('amount')
    if sender_email in recipient_emails:
        exp_amt = share_amounts_by_email[sender_email]

        if round(float(amt),2) == round(float(exp_amt),2):

print('paid_emails inferred:', paid_emails)

unpaid = [r for r in recipients if r['email'] not in paid_emails]

print('counts: recipients', len(recipients), 'paid', len(paid_emails), 'unpaid', len(unpaid))

        description='Work Dinner'

    print('created', res)

# Verification: confirm created Venmo payment requests exist and match expected fields
venmo_token = globals().get('venmo_token')
expected = {6097: {'email':'saritt@gmail.com','amount':19.0,'description':'Work Dinner'},
            6098: {'email':'stmcco@gmail.com','amount':20.0,'description':'Work Dinner'},
            6099: {'email':'tra_wils@gmail.com','amount':39.0,'description':'Work Dinner'}}

# Fetch all sent payment requests (pagination)
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_sent=[]
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    all_sent.extend(res)
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

print('total_sent_payment_requests_fetched', len(all_sent))

# Extract those created
found=[]
for pr in all_sent:
    pid = pr.get('payment_request_id')
    if pid in expected:
        found.append(pr)

found_sorted = sorted(found, key=lambda x: x.get('payment_request_id'))
print('found_created_requests_count', len(found_sorted))
for pr in found_sorted:
    pid = pr['payment_request_id']

# Compare against expected
matches=[]
for pid, exp in expected.items():
    pr = next((x for x in found_sorted if x.get('payment_request_id')==pid), None)

        matches.append((pid, False, 'missing'))
        continue
    ok = (pr.get('description') == exp['description'] and pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email')==exp['email'] and round(float(pr.get('amount',0.0)),2)==round(float(exp['amount']),2))
    matches.append((pid, ok, pr.get('description'), pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email'), pr.get('amount')))

print('match_results')
for m in matches:
